invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata instance.
The WriteStatuses in the result are always set before returning.
The method uses clusteringPlan without null checks, indicating it must be non-null.
instantTime parameter is used as a string without null checks, implying it is non-null.
The writeStatuses list is constructed from a possibly empty list, so size is non-negative.
